packageRules.description: fedora base image major bumps are IGNORED (not even proposed): the fedora:46/rawhide image's dnf repos serve fc45-built packages with a keyring mismatch, breaking container builds (tuna-os/tacklebox#205). automerge:false alone did not stop renovate (PRs #209/#211 auto-merged); ignore prevents PR creation entirely. Remove this rule once the upstream image is consistent.
